The *Jatukaṇṇimāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 15) is an exegetical text belonging to the *Cūḷaniddesa* section of the Khuddaka Nikāya [SuttaCentral]. It constitutes an extensive canonical commentary (*niddesa*) on the *Jatukaṇṇimāṇavapucchā*, the twelfth discourse of the *Pārāyanavagga* in the *Sutta Nipāta* (Snp 5.12) [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral also notes cross-references or connections to several related texts within the canon, including the *Jhānasutta* (AN 9.36), the *Sabhiya Sutta* (Snp 3.6), the *Tuvaṭakasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 14), and other *Niddesa* expositions such as Cnd 2, Cnd 16, and Cnd 23 [SuttaCentral].
Computational text-reuse analysis shows that the *Jatukaṇṇimāṇavapucchāniddesa* shares an extensive network of formulaic and doctrinal vocabulary with the wider *Niddesa* corpus and other Pali canonical works, with 1,666 matching passages distributed across 86 Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. Its most substantial internal parallels and shared textual blocks occur with other exegetical treatises, most prominently the *Attadaṇḍasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 15), the *Khaggavisāṇasuttaniddesa* (Cnd 23), the *Piṅgiyamāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 20), the *Mettagūmāṇavapucchāniddesa* (Cnd 8), the *Pārāyanānugītigāthāniddesa* (Cnd 22), and the *Tuvaṭakasuttaniddesa* (Mnd 14) [DharmaNexus].
